about_the_game:
Sent to collect minerals. Drawn to uncover mysteries.

Your mission starts simple: excavate valuable ores from a forgotten alien planet. The digging is satisfying—carve through layers of terrain, watch voxels crumble, collect resources. But the deeper you go, the more you realize you're not mining a dead world. You're excavating a tomb.

Explore the ruins of a dwarf-like alien civilization. Navigate subterranean chambers where architecture feels wrong, where silence is too complete, and where you can't shake the feeling of being observed. Upgrade your excavation tools to break through harder materials and reach deeper layers. Enhance your jetpack for better mobility. Manage your battery to survive extended expeditions into the depths.

Progression unlocks mysteries. Each tool upgrade grants access to new areas and deeper secrets. Traverse multiple atmospheric biomes, each with unique geology and enigmatic structures. Discover relics and fragments that hint at what happened here—and what might still remain.

Dignaut is not about combat or puzzles. It's about the tension between satisfying excavation and atmospheric dread. It's about choosing to dig deeper even when every instinct whispers that you shouldn't.

The tools are just a means to go deeper and deeper.

Key Features: 

⛏️ Experience satisfying voxel excavation with diverse and evolving excavation tools

💎 Collect minerals and upgrade your equipment to push your descent further

🏛️ Explore a variety of biomes and uncover hidden places that reveal deeper layers of the ancient mystery

🌌 Feel the meditative yet subtly unsettling atmosphere of an alien world

🔄 Play through a progression-driven journey where each upgrade opens new depths and stranger discoveries

You were sent to dig. Now you decide how deep this goes.
